subject: Recap: Discovery — usage estimates, budget bands, and model allocation

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap: Discovery — usage estimates, budget bands, and model allocation

Hi Danielle — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and next steps so we’re aligned. I’ve attached the usage worksheet we filled in during the call.

High-level summary (from your inputs):
- Usage profile: prototypes -> pilot -> prod. Expected ramp: 200k tokens/day month 1 -> 1.8M tokens/day by month 6.
- Monthly target: roughly 6M tokens (conservative) to 55M tokens (aggressive) in the first 6 months depending on feature rollout.
- Budget band you indicated: $800 — $3,500 / month initially (seed/pilot), with potential to expand to $12k–$25k/mo at scale.
- Model mix (your preference): embeddings-heavy for search/retrieval (~50%), chat assistant for UI interactions (~35%), rerank for candidate filtering (~15%).

Key asks from us:
1) Confirm monthly token bands and whether those numbers are "tokens in" (requests) or total tokens (requests + responses).
2) Confirm target unit economics: you mentioned target ~$12–20 / 1M tokens effective spend — can you confirm a firm target or a range?
3) Any compliance constraints (log retention, region) beyond what we covered — you said SOC2 + EU requests for some customers.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm the token counting methodology (in vs total) + preferred budget tier.
- Us: produce a short pilot proposal (3–4 week pilot) with a price estimate by model, plus a unit-cost table ($ / 1M tokens) and two pilot options (embeddings-first vs chat-first).

Attachments: Acme-usage-estimates.xlsx (worksheet we completed), redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (starter pricing band).

If we can get your confirms today or early tomorrow, I’ll push the pilot proposal to you by Thursday.

Thanks,
Aisha

Thanks Aisha — this is great and matches my notes. A few clarifications below.

- Token counting: our internal reporting uses request tokens only (we strip down responses for metrics). For billing discussions, we prefer total tokens (request + response) but are open to whichever is simpler for the pilot. For the pilot estimate, please use total tokens.
- Budgets: initial pilot budget will be closer to $1,800–2,500/mo. If the pilot shows the retrieval stack reduces downstream work, we’ll scale quickly to the mid $10k range.
- Model mix: yes — embeddings will be the biggest portion. Typical per-user sequence lengths: 64 tokens for embeddings requests; chat interactions average 420 tokens total; rerank footprints are small (~30 tokens per candidate). We expect ~40k embedding calls/day at peak month 1, rising to ~400k/day by month 6.
- Compliance: SOC2 is required; EU customer data must stay in EU regions when requested — for the pilot we’ll be US-only.

Let me know if you need any more detail on the candidate counts for rerank; I can pull a small sample.

—Danielle

Hey team — ran numbers off the worksheet and pricing bands. Summary below (pilot & scale projections).

Assumptions we used:
- Billing = total tokens (request + response) as Danielle requested for pilot.
- Embedding request/response: average 64 tokens request, 0 tokens response (vector only) -> count as 64 tokens per call.
- Chat average: 420 tokens total per interaction.
- Rerank: assume 30 tokens per candidate * average 5 candidates = 150 tokens per rerank call.

Pilot scenarios:
1) Conservative pilot (6M tokens/month):
   - Mix: embeddings 50% (3.0M), chat 35% (2.1M), rerank 15% (0.9M)
   - Our list price estimates (starter): embeddings variant (quantized-int8) $8 / 1M, chat (fp16) $28 / 1M, rerank (int8) $12 / 1M
   - Weighted blended cost: ((3.0*$8)+(2.1*$28)+(0.9*$12))/6 = $15.7 per 1M -> monthly cost ~ $94.2 (list)
   - With standard pilot discount (35%) -> ~$61/mo. This is well under their stated $1.8–2.5k pilot budget; leaves room for additional usage or higher perf variants.

2) Aggressive pilot (20M tokens/month):
   - Mix kept same: embeddings 50% (10M), chat 35% (7M), rerank 15% (3M)
   - List monthly cost = ((10*$8)+(7*$28)+(3*$12)) = $80 + $196 + $36 = $312 -> $15.6 per 1M (similar blended)
   - With volume/commit discounts (50% at this scale) -> ~$156/mo. Still below their $10k target at scale, suggesting we either:
     a) They’ve been thinking of $/month for full feature + infra, or
     b) Their product has other downstream costs — flag for AM.

Recommendations / notes:
- Our per-1M list numbers above are conservative; we can offer quantized embeddings by default. For chat, recommend fp16 for better latency/quality tradeoff during pilot; propose offering an experimental int8 chat variant if they want an aggressive cost target.
- If they insist on an "effective spend" of ~$12 / 1M tokens, we can hit that by combining: embeddings int8 ($6/1M) + chat int8 experimental ($18/1M) and an upfront pilot credit structure. I can model an exact blended table if they give a firm target.
- Compliance: Monica — we can host pilot in US-only region. SOC2 evidence: we have standard SOC2 attestation; I’ll loop security if they need deeper artifacts.
- Legal: Sergio — recommend a short SOW + pilot appendix (30 days, simple data terms). Use the DocuSign template in the Drive link; include a $500 pilot fee only if they require reserved capacity.

Next step: Aisha, if you’re comfortable with the conservative and aggressive pilot options above, I’ll produce a one-page pricing matrix and an email you can send Danielle (with two recommended pilot bundles and the blended $/1M numbers).

Karthik
